description.value:
Casting saber throw while wielding your forceblade lets you strike the same target more than once with the power.

Additionally, when you damage a creature within 30 feet of you using your forceblade, you may spend a bonus action to teleport to within 5 feet of that creature and follow up with a melee weapon attack, dealing damage using your Kinetic Combat die instead of your weapon's normal damage die. You can use this ability three times, gaining one more use at 9th, 13th, and 17th level, and you regain all spent uses after a long rest.
